## Why it made the list

An 85 m² restored, habitable semi-detached house in the car-free historic centre of San Siro, on the west shore of Lake Como. Two floors plus a mezzanine: entrance hall, bedroom and shower room downstairs; a bright living room with fireplace and wooden beams and a separate kitchen upstairs; an attic bedroom with two Velux windows. Lake views from the living floor and the mezzanine. Sold fully furnished, with a separate cellar. Asking €115,000, about €1,353/m².
